purpose: Teach: オピニオン/図解/読み込み/終電/賃料/昇給/良品/単品

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔のオピニオン誌、よく読んだものだ。
lines.en: I read those opinion magazines quite often, back then.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Each word placed with quiet weight. Patient pause between clauses. The voice of someone who has carried these memories for decades. No rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員教育、図解を多用してます。
lines.en: Yes. We use a lot of diagrams in our staff training materials.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Crisp articulation on the key point 「図解」. Direct eye contact implied. The careful listening of someone being taught by someone who matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 契約の読み込み、若いうちに、徹底させろ。
lines.en: Have them read contracts thoroughly while they're young. Make it strict.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Light authority resting naturally in the voice. A teaching moment — the tone of someone passing on hard-won wisdom. No softening.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。終電過ぎる労働、ゼロを目指します。
lines.en: Yes. We're aiming for zero hours worked after the last train.
lines.style: Steady commitment in the voice. Not defensive — this is already decided. Measured pace. The assurance of someone who means what he says and is saying it to his superior.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、賃料を節約して、自社ビルを買った。
lines.en: When I was young, I cut back on rent and bought our own building.
lines.style: Quiet pride, not boastful. The opening is matter-of-fact. Slight nostalgic softening mid-sentence. Trailing off gently — the voice of someone sharing a piece of his own path.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員の昇給、信頼の対価です。
lines.en: Yes. Staff salary increases are the return on trust.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate. Weight placed on 「信頼」 — this is philosophy, not transaction. Warm but formal. The voice understanding something larger about his responsibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 良品にこだわるな、顧客にこだわれ。
lines.en: Don't chase perfection in the product — chase the customer.
lines.style: Sharp attention-shift. The opening carries mild correction wrapped in wisdom. Slower second half, sinking the lesson in. Not lecturing — inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。単品メニューでも、お客様、満足頂きたい。
lines.en: Yes. Even with a limited menu, I want every customer to leave satisfied.
lines.style: Quiet resolution. The opening acknowledgement is quick; the main clause settles into commitment. Slight warmth on 「お客様」. The close of someone who has heard wisdom and will carry it forward.
